latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of video-editor-hiring.

- Automates editing of raw video footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) into polished 1080p MP4s in 1–2 minutes.
- Handles video upload, AI-driven edits (cuts, transitions, text/audio overlays), and cloud-based export.
- Session management with free trial support; 100 free credits valid for 7 days (auto-retrieved if needed).
- Provides workflow for uploading, editing, previewing, and exporting videos; supports batch and iterative editing.
- Returns download URLs for finished files; full support for common formats.
- Clear error handling for tokens, session issues, upload problems, and plan limits.
